entities.name: Armando Xavier Ochoa

entities.summary: Armando Xavier Ochoa is an American Catholic retired prelate who served as bishop of Fresno in California, bishop of El Paso in Texas and as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Los Angeles in California.
